difference_witness.probe: For a candidate truncated approximation A_T(n), compare B_T(n)=A_T(n)+c with c != 0.
difference_witness.verdict: The offset pair is not two admissible worlds for the same RH target. It is a valid warning for increment-only reconstruction in the abstract, but it cannot establish that RH-ANA-003a lacks an endpoint anchor.

disanalogies: In the RH target, each Li coefficient lambda_n is independently fixed by the zero-sum/xi-function definition for each integer n; it is not defined only modulo an additive constant.
Lagarias records the arithmetic form lambda_n = S_infinity(n) - S_f(n) + 1, which contains source-native absolute terms.
The RH Li index n is distinct from a prime/zero truncation cutoff; the Yang-Mills scale/telescope index is the variable on which the source endpoint ambiguity acts.
An additive shift preserving cutoff increments changes the source-defined lambda_n and therefore leaves the exact RH target fibre.
enabling_assumptions: the target argument would rely only on increment differences or a telescope with no independent absolute normalization
source and target indices denote compatible approximation directions
adding a cutoff-independent constant preserves every hypothesis used by the target route
transfer.predicted_principle: Endpoint-anchor warnings transfer only when the target representation retains an additive gauge/quotient ambiguity under all load-bearing observations; an independently source-normalized target blocks that transfer.
